source: Blind/post-blind report of one Sandia team, OSTI 3013870 (text and Figs 2-6, 5-1), read by a separate reader after the prediction was committed in e6173e0; the organisers' own summary and per-test fastener table were not found

Q1_first_fastener_fracture.note: the Sandia team's own blind prediction was also early (about tests 8-10, 80-85 ft/s)

Q2_all_six.measured_note: lowest all-six test about 104 ft/s from a figure read-off; the report's text and figure disagree (text says roughly 110-115 ft/s)
Q2_all_six.error_test_steps: -1 (nominal) to about +2, depending on which reading of the report is right

Q3_per_test: not gradable test by test (no per-test table). Qualitatively wrong: predicted progressive loss from test 9 (3, then 5, then 6 fasteners); observed no fastener fracture before test 14, then all-or-nothing and stochastic (three tests all six, three tests one to three, others none)
Q5_other_failure: WRONG: predicted no fracture of the cantilever. Observed: the aluminium cantilever cracked in nearly every test, with through-cracks from about test 9, and cantilever failure competed with fastener failure. The agent did flag permanent flange bending in every test, but did not model cracking
